scope: Context-sensitive working glossary from direct translation and cited dictionaries. Not expert review; never apply as blind substitutions.

entries.context: Armor on outer arm; not a weapon or official.
Historical administrative rank among Xinjiang Kalmyks/Mongols. Context may instead use Kalday as a name/title; do not replace names automatically.
Rank. Preserve proper character names Ay Jangjung and Kün Jangjung.
High-status woman, sometimes with mocking bound-foot associations; not a military rank.

entries.en: with dark rings on the legs
entries.context: Horse coat markings in horse context; bracelet-bearing in human context.
Horse color, same as кула; do not conflate with armspan кулач.

entries.en: so fat the rump is hollowed
entries.context: Horse body condition; чөйчөк ал- describes groove between fat sides of rump.
Directional formula; not qibla or sermon in this context.
Exact Karalaev Semetey formula cited in 2015 explanatory dictionary under dust/dispersal. Manas356 has visible тос; retain raw and note interpretive reading.
Whole headword; do not split as кереш plus dative. Forest/shelter metaphor in246, with боз nuance provisional.
In forest metaphor; other senses need context.
In the strength-gathering formula all the strength he had, not Almighty. Yudakhin quotes that formula explicitly.

entries.en: guarded by the unseen patron; favored with victory
entries.context: Epic formula referring to unseen protector of heroes, related to Shaimerden; not equipment in this context.

entries.en: with rank buttons on their caps
entries.context: Chinese/Kalmyk officials wearing distinguishing cap balls/buttons. Not stone worship. With таза the formula praises finest officials, not baldness. Preserve case, subject and surrounding syntax.
Honorific for an outstanding victorious hero. Working English title retained consistently; not a spouse or ordinary person.
Exact epic oath formula, often paired with chewing white wheat flour; do not reduce to generic profession of faith.
Load-bearing camel context uses support, edition glossary1841:l011; not the irrigator homonym мурап.

entries.en: tie a horse with its head drawn high
entries.context: Horse-resting formula; not noun аса religious staff.
кезек II/III=кесек II, abusive epithets in1043–1044. Not queue, turn, or proper name.
